retail_run.platform: Xbox 360 retail game through the Linux guest runtime
retail_run.renderer: project-owned native Vulkan plugin; Xenos GPU-emulation renderer disabled

draw_27.current_result: DP3 no longer blocks translation; the captured pixel shader now reaches an unsupported scalar-result opcode.
draw_27.captured_run_error: captured ALU scalar opcode writes an unsupported result
draw_27.limitation: This run used the plugin before the detailed scalar-opcode diagnostic was rebuilt, so the opcode number and instruction slot remain unknown.

draw_28.previous_blocker: captured DXT4/5 descriptor with aliased base and mip page rejected
draw_28.current_result: The updated run contains no unresolved-draw rejection for draw 28; the alias is handled as base-level-only. Distinct mip pages remain unsupported without captured mip payload data.

frame_refresh.current_result: The Vulkan frame refresh remains fail-closed for the 24-draw frame.
frame_refresh.error: mixed 4x-to-1x depth/stencil preservation requires a provider-confirmed enabled resolve capability
frame_refresh.cause: The SDK checkout used by the live process predates the optional depth/stencil resolve provider contract.

diagnostic_change.behavior: Unsupported scalar-result errors now include the scalar opcode and instruction slot. The translator also implements Xenos scalar FLOOR opcode 13 as floor(src0.a).
diagnostic_change.regression: native_vulkan/tests/xbox_shader_translate_check.cpp checks opcode 13 floor emission and verifies that unsupported opcode 63 reports its number and instruction slot 7.
diagnostic_change.live_plugin_note: The running retail process was left untouched and has not loaded this floor/diagnostic build; the current captured shader's scalar opcode remains unconfirmed.

checks.linux_native_vulkan_ctest: 4/4 passed; renderer regression ran with VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation.
checks.linux_rexglue_plugin_ctest: 4/4 passed against the separate ReXGlue PR #2 provider branch, including the resolve capability regression.

android_arm64_shader_translation.device: Redmi Note 8 Pro (begonia), Mali-G76 MC4, Android 13

provider_contract.status: Built and tested on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 with VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation: provider resolve pair=1, SAMPLE_ZERO=1, GPU-emulation features=disabled. This is provider capability evidence, not a retail-frame resolve result.

loading_bar_reference.observation: The user-confirmed yellow-orange filled section and dark-gray empty section match the captured retail frame.

visual_result.claim: Submitted draw packets and shader decoding progress are implementation evidence only; the failed frame refresh does not establish a displayed retail frame or parity.

windows: Both existing NFS Shift processes were left running; neither was closed or restarted for this diagnostic-only build.
